name: cortex-chat
description: Your Cortex in the Claude app's Chat tab: see your card, search and open your pages, save a chat and add to-dos. Your pages stay in a folder on this computer.

tools.name: cortex_inbox
tools.description: List what is waiting to be filed.

tools.name: cortex_save_chat
tools.description: Propose this chat as a note in the inbox.

tools.name: cortex_accept
tools.description: File a proposal as a new session page.

cortex_folder.title: Cortex folder
cortex_folder.description: The folder that holds your Cortex. If you have no Cortex yet, leave this as it is and say "set up my cortex" in a chat. If ~/.cortex/config.json exists, that file decides the folder and this setting is ignored.
